balance.select_client: Select a client to see the money moved with them.
balance.empty: No money has moved with this client yet.

help.intro: The ledger is the record of money that actually changed hands with a client - one signed row per completed cash flow. Nothing on this screen writes to it: rows are added by the settlement chain as payments and refunds complete, and never edited after.
help.step_1_body: The ledger is always read for one client, so the list stays empty until the client filter names one. Entry type, currency and the date range narrow it from there.
help.step_2_body: Above the list, one card per currency: what was received, what was paid back and the net of the two. Currencies are never added together - the base-currency figure is converted at the rate frozen on each row, for reporting only.
help.step_3_body: A payment received from the client is positive, a refund paid back to them negative. A refund is filed under the client of the payment it reverses.
help.step_4_title: Follow an entry to its cash flow
help.step_4_body: Each row points at the cash flow that wrote it - open it to see the method, the reference and the documents it settled. Pending, failed or canceled movements write nothing here.
help.note: The net is money moved, not money owed: what a client still has to pay is read from their invoices. A nightly job books any completed movement the ledger is missing, so a payment completed while the feature was not installed shows up by the next morning.
